- [ ] Every shape the type accepts renders, in every variant: a `ReactNode` prop shows a string, an element and a list alike.
- [ ] A hidden copy kept for animation is `aria-hidden`, and a collapsed region is `inert`.
- [ ] Native semantics first: `<button>`, `<a href>`, `<input>` and Base UI's roles, with ARIA only for what no element says.
- [ ] Focus moves in reading order, and closing anything returns it to where it came from.
- [ ] Every target is at least `size.target-min` square.
- [ ] Loops stop when the system asks for less motion.

The rest of the WCAG 2.2 AA target is on [Accessibility](../foundations/accessibility.md).

## Words

- Visible content comes from the caller, as `children` or a prop: a button's text, a dialog's title.
- A string the component owns, such as a pagination button's "Previous page" or a dialog's "Close", comes from the locale dictionaries in `packages/perron/src/locale/` (`en.ts`, `da.ts`, `sv.ts`, `nb.ts`), in the locale `PerronProvider` sets. A new one is a key in `en.ts` and in each of the others.
- Each owned string has a `<key>Label` prop that overrides it on one instance: `close` is `closeLabel`. The component reads its strings with the overrides laid over them: `const strings = useOwnedStrings({ close: closeLabel })`, from `packages/perron/src/PerronProvider.tsx`.
- Owned strings follow [content design](../content-design.md): sentence case, the fixed data-state words, no exclamation marks. The spec gives the English; agents write the Danish, Swedish and Norwegian.
- `expectOwnedStrings(markup, locale, callerStrings)`, from `packages/perron/src/testing/owned-strings.ts`, fails a render that shows or announces a word neither the locale's dictionary nor the caller gave. The contract story runs it over every component (see [Stories](#stories)); a component with more words in another state, such as an open dialog's close label, calls it in its own test on that render: `expectOwnedStrings(renderToStaticMarkup(<PerronProvider locale="da">…</PerronProvider>), 'da', ['Departures'])`.

## Stories

- The default export is `satisfies Meta<typeof <Name>>`, with `component` set and `title: 'Components/<Name>'`.
- One story per variant and state the Penpot design shows, named as Penpot names it, so the visual check pairs each story with its export.
- A `play` test for every behaviour the component promises (dismissal, focus, keyboard), ending in the resting state: popups closed and focus back where it started.
- The docs page, the visual stage and the audits show each story's first render, as its args leave it; its `play` runs as a test (`npm run test:stories`) and in the story's canvas. `.storybook/preview.ts` sets this for every story. So an overlay's story opens it with `defaultOpen`, beside the trigger that opens it again, and the docs page shows it open. An overlay portals to `<body>` and may lock the page, so its meta sets `parameters: { docs: { story: { inline: false, height: '480px' } } }`, a height that fits the open overlay, and each story renders in its own frame. Its `play` finds the popup through `screen`, the whole document, since the popup is outside `canvasElement`, and closes it at the end. A story whose `play` the docs page should run renders inline with `parameters.docs.story.autoplay: true`.
- A `play` that measures text asserts relations: it wraps onto more than one line, it stays inside its column, nothing overflows. An exact line count or a text height in pixels is never one, since CI's Linux renders the same fonts a little wider or narrower than a Mac. `.storybook/preview.ts` loads the library's fonts before every story renders, so a story never waits for them itself.
- Stories run in Chromium with axe in `error` mode (`npm run test:stories`, part of `npm run check`), so an axe violation fails CI. The contract story's `Keyboard` story is the `play` pattern to copy: Tab to the element, expect focus, Shift+Tab back.
- The contract story's `OwnedStrings` story renders every component and pattern with its subject story's args (see [Root](#root)), in `en`, `da`, `sv` and `nb`, and runs `expectOwnedStrings` on each render, with the strings in those args as the caller's words. So those args hold every word the caller gives.

## Patterns

A pattern is a piece of a Mylder screen, such as a departure row. It follows this contract, with three differences:

- Its files are in `packages/perron/src/patterns/<Name>/`, in the same four shapes, its stories are titled `Patterns/<Name>`, and its spec is `docs/patterns/<name>.md`.
- Its code imports only Perron's components and parts, `PerronProvider`, the helpers of `packages/perron/src/internal/nodes.ts`, React and the files of its own folder, never `@base-ui/react`. A type-only import from another package is fine, and its stories and tests are not its code.
- It takes Mylder's domain props, such as a departure or a line, and its CSS reads the pattern row of [Token families](#token-families).

It is exported from `@mylder/perron/patterns`.

## Checks

Each rule is one script, `scripts/checks/<rule>.ts`. `npm run gates` runs them all, as part of `npm run check`, `npm run gates -- <rule>` runs one, and a PascalCase name after it, `npm run gates -- docs <Name>`, keeps only that component's or pattern's problems. A deliberate exception is written in place, on the line it excuses or the line above it, with one rule and a reason:

```css
/* perron-allow(component-css): the map canvas reads this length in script */
```

In Markdown it is an HTML comment holding `perron-allow(paths): reason`, at the end of the line it excuses: prettier sets a comment on its own line apart from the text below it. A rule whose breach has no line, `docs` and `api-compatibility`, takes no allowance, and nor does `penpot`, whose files are JSON. Every run of the gates also fails an allowance that names no rule or gives no reason, wherever it is.

| Rule                | Fails on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `component-css`     | A [CSS](#css) rule broken: a raw value, a `var()` fallback, a `--perron-*` name no token defines, a token outside its layer's [families](#token-families), a query outside [Media queries](#media-queries), a loop that never stops, a typography role with no long-word rule                                                                                                   |
| `props`             | A `<Name>Props`, or any other `*Props` its `<Name>.tsx` exports for a compound component's parts, read with the TypeScript compiler, outside the [Props](#props) table's types, with a [name from other libraries](#names-from-other-libraries), an `is`, `has` or `should` boolean, a member without JSDoc, or a `render` it declares itself rather than inherits from Base UI |
| `patterns`          | A [pattern](#patterns) importing anything but Perron components and parts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `shared-parts`      | A [shared part](#shared-parts)'s class, icon or declarations outside its folder, or a [shared helper](#shared-helpers) declared outside its file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `docs`              | A registered entry without its spec from `building` on, its `<Name>.mdx` from `stable` on (see [Files](#files)), code from which the docs page's docgen reads no props, a member without a spec Props row or a row without a member, or a prop whose default it reads otherwise than the spec gives                                                                             |
| `api-compatibility` | A `stable` or `deprecated` entry's props API shrinking against the last release tag (see [Change](#change))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `paths`             | A path a doc or skill names, in a link or a code span, that does not exist                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `penpot`            | A design read back with an unknown token, an unbound value, or an unmapped variant or layer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

title: Spec template
markdown:
# Spec template

The page every component's spec starts from. The `component-brief` skill copies it to `docs/components/<name>.md` and fills it from the read-back (`penpot/<name>.json`), the code map (`penpot/<name>.code-map.json`) and `get_reference` for each Base UI part, by the rules of the [contract](../components/README.md).

How to fill it:

- Replace this heading with the component's name, `# Button`, and this paragraph and list with one sentence on what the component is for.
- Fill every `<…>` placeholder, and replace the example rows with the component's own.
- Write a question the sources can't answer in place, as `[PENDING] <the question>`, and put it to the maintainer. Its answer replaces the whole line with the decision, a statement with its reason, and no "Answered" label. The spec is done when every section is filled and no `[PENDING]` is left.
- Link only a page the docs site serves: the foundations, the guidelines, the contract and the other specs. Write any other repo path, such as an ADR (`docs/adr/0010-unattended-runs-with-design-deferred.md`), `penpot/README.md` or the read-back, as a code span, as the contract does; `scripts/lib/site.test.ts` fails on a link the site can't follow.
- Keep every section, in this order. A section that doesn't apply says why in one line: "No owned strings: every word comes from the caller."

## Anatomy

Penpot page `Components/<Name>`. Family: `<Rows | Fields | Popups | Panels | Tooltips | none>`. Shared parts: `<VisuallyHidden, CheckboxIndicator, SelectedMark, CloseButton, or none>`.

| Part (Penpot layer) | What it is                      | Base UI part         | Class              | `slotProps` key |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------ | --------------- |
| `root`              | `<what the root is>`            | `<Component>.Root`   | `pn-<Name>`        | none            |
| `<part>`            | `<what this part is and holds>` | `<Component>.<Part>` | `pn-<Name>-<part>` | `<part>`        |

## Base UI parts

Imported from `@base-ui/react/<component>`, at the version pinned in `package.json`.

| Base UI part         | Renders     | Perron sets                                 | Passed through               |
| -------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `<Component>.Root`   | `<element>` | `<props the component sets, and from what>` | `<props the caller reaches>` |
| `<Component>.<Part>` | `<element>` | `<…>`                                       | `slotProps.<part>`           |

Base UI already does: `<behaviour Base UI handles, such as typeahead or focus return>`.

## Props

In MUI's layout, one row per prop the docs page shows, slots last: each prop the component declares, its description becoming the JSDoc, and each it inherits from Base UI, such as `render`, which reads `inherited` under Base UI prop and gives Base UI's type, default and description while the code inherits it as it is (the contract's [Props](../components/README.md#props)).

| Name                        | Type                              | Default      | Base UI prop         | Description                                         |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `variant`                   | `'<value>' \| '<value>'`          | `'<value>'`  | none                 | `<what each value is for>`                          |
| `size`                      | `'small' \| 'medium' \| 'large'`  | `'medium'`   | none                 | `<…>`                                               |
| `disabled`                  | `boolean`                         | `false`      | `disabled`           | `<…>`                                               |
| `onChange`                  | `(event, value, details) => void` |              | `onValueChange`      | `<when it fires>`                                   |
| `render`                    | Base UI's `render`                |              | inherited            | `<Base UI's description>`                           |
| `className`, `style`, `ref` | React's                           |              | none                 | Reach the root; `className` joins after `pn-<Name>` |
| `<key>Label`                | `string`                          | The locale's | none                 | Overrides "`<English text>`"                        |
| `slotProps.<part>`          | `<Component>.<Part>.Props`        |              | `<Component>.<Part>` | Props for the `<part>` part                         |

## Tokens

One row per part, state and property. States are the contract's design states: rest, hover, highlighted, focus, pressed, disabled, open, selected, invalid. A value no token gives is `[PENDING] needs a token for <what>`, answered through the `design-tokens` skill.

| Part     | State | Property           | Token                    |
| -------- | ----- | ------------------ | ------------------------ |
| `root`   | rest  | `background`       | `<color.surface.raised>` |
| `root`   | hover | `background-image` | `<color.surface.hover>`  |
| `<part>` | rest  | `<property>`       | `<token>`                |

## Keyboard and ARIA

From the Base UI reference for each part. "From" says who does it: Base UI, or Perron.

| Key       | Does     | From        |
| --------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `<Enter>` | `<what>` | `<Base UI>` |

| Element  | Role     | Accessible name from                           | States announced     |
| -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `<part>` | `<role>` | `<children, aria-labelledby, an owned string>` | `<aria-expanded, …>` |

What axe won't catch, from the contract, each with how this component meets it:

- [ ] Everything the eye is told, the ear is told, for every shape each prop accepts: `<how>`
- [ ] Every landmark and named region has an accessible name: `<how, or none here>`
- [ ] Every default label can be overridden: `<the *Label props>`
- [ ] Every shape the type accepts renders, in every variant: `<how>`
- [ ] A hidden copy kept for animation is `aria-hidden`, and a collapsed region is `inert`: `<how, or none here>`
- [ ] Native semantics first: `<the native elements and Base UI roles used>`
- [ ] Focus moves in reading order and returns on close: `<how>`
- [ ] Every target is at least `size.target-min` square: `<the smallest target>`
- [ ] Loops stop when the system asks for less motion: `<how, or none here>`

## Owned strings

Every word the component shows or announces on its own. Reuse a key `packages/perron/src/locale/en.ts` already has; a new key gets its English here, and agents write the Danish, Swedish and Norwegian in the locale files.

| Key     | English           | Override     | Seen or heard where                   |
| ------- | ----------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `<key>` | `<Sentence case>` | `<key>Label` | `<the part, and how it is announced>` |

## Component rules

Rules for this component alone, numbered so the build and the review can cite them.

- **CR-1.** `<rule>`. Example: Base UI's Select already handles typeahead, so the component doesn't rebuild it.

## Stories

One per variant and state the Penpot design shows, named as Penpot names it, and one row per story the stories file exports, under its export name (the `docs` gate holds the two to each other). The contract story renders the [subject story](README.md#root) with axe on, so its Shows cell says it is the subject and its args pass every rule alone.

| Story           | Shows                       | `play` test                          |
| --------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `<Penpot name>` | `<variant, size and state>` | `<the behaviour it proves, or none>` |

## Do and don't

For a caller using the component, with the reason.

| Do                         | Don't                      |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `<the right use, and why>` | `<the misuse it replaces>` |

title: Button
markdown:
# Button

A button that runs one action on the screen it sits on, such as "Show departures", in ink (`neutral`) or, for the one main action of a screen, in the brand yellow (`brand`).

The design is deferred (ADR 0010, `docs/adr/0010-unattended-runs-with-design-deferred.md`): this spec decides what the drawing would. The read-back `penpot/button.json`, drawn before the contract gave action components the `brand` colour, is one source among the contract, the foundations and the tokens, and the spec follows it wherever it holds.

## Anatomy

Penpot page `Components/Button`. Family: none (the contract's [Families](README.md#families) give buttons only their text, `typography.label`). Shared parts: none.

| Part (Penpot layer) | What it is                                                                                                                                           | Base UI part                                           | Class                 | `slotProps` key |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------- | --------------- |
| `root`              | The native `<button>`: a flex row, centred, that holds the start icon, the label and the end icon in reading order                                   | `Button`                                               | `pn-Button`           | none            |
| `label`             | A `<span>` that holds the caller's `children`                                                                                                        | none: a span inside `Button`, which has no inner parts | `pn-Button-label`     | none            |
| `startIcon`         | A `<span>`, `aria-hidden`, that holds the caller's `startIcon` before the label; only rendered when `startIcon` is given                             | none: a span inside `Button`                           | `pn-Button-startIcon` | none            |
| `endIcon`           | A `<span>`, `aria-hidden`, that holds the caller's `endIcon` after the label; only rendered when `endIcon` is given. Not in the read-back: see Props | none: a span inside `Button`                           | `pn-Button-endIcon`   | none            |
| `focusRing`         | The keyboard focus ring. The code map lands it on `root`: it is the `:focus-visible` outline `perron.css` draws on the root, not an element          | `Button`                                               | none                  | none            |

## Base UI parts

Imported from `@base-ui/react/button`, at the version pinned in `package.json` (1.9.0 installed).

| Base UI part | Renders                                                                                     | Perron sets                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Passed through                                                                                                                        |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Button`     | `<button type="button">`, or the element `render` gives, with `data-disabled` when disabled | `className` (`pn-Button`, then the caller's), `style`, `ref`, `disabled` from `disabled`, `data-variant`, `data-color` and `data-size` from their props (defaults included), `data-full-width` when `fullWidth`, and the children: the icon spans and the label span | `render`, `nativeButton`, `focusableWhenDisabled`, `type`, `onClick` and every other prop of a native `<button>`, through `{...rest}` |

Base UI already does: it renders a native `<button>` with `type="button"`, which a caller's `type="submit"` overrides; Enter and Space activate it through the browser; when disabled it sets the native `disabled` attribute and `data-disabled`, and stops `onClick`, `onMouseDown` and `onPointerDown` from reaching the caller; with `focusableWhenDisabled` it sets `aria-disabled` in place of `disabled`, keeps the button in the tab order and lets only Tab through; with `render` and `nativeButton={false}` it gives a non-button element `role="button"`, a `tabIndex` and Enter and Space activation, and in development it warns when `nativeButton` doesn't match the rendered element.

## Props

In MUI's layout. Every prop here gets this description as its JSDoc. Slots come last.

| Name                        | Type                   | Default     | Base UI prop            | Description                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `variant`                   | `'solid' \| 'outline'` | `'solid'`   | none                    | How much the button stands out: `solid` is filled, for the action a panel is for; `outline` is an edge only, for the actions beside it.             |
| `color`                     | `'neutral' \| 'brand'` | `'neutral'` | none                    | The intent: `neutral` is ink, for every action but the main one; `brand` is the brand yellow, for the one main action of a screen.                  |
| `size`                      | `'small' \| 'medium'`  | `'medium'`  | none                    | The button's height: `medium` is `size.button`, `small` is `size.button-sm`, for dense rows and panels.                                             |
| `disabled`                  | `boolean`              | `false`     | `disabled`              | Whether the button ignores the pointer and the keys. A disabled button leaves the tab order unless `focusableWhenDisabled` is set.                  |
| `fullWidth`                 | `boolean`              | `false`     | none                    | Whether the button fills the width of its container, such as a bottom sheet's main action. Sets `data-full-width`.                                  |
| `startIcon`                 | `ReactNode`            | none        | none                    | An icon before the label, in reading order, so it moves to the right in right-to-left text. Hidden from screen readers: the label names the button. |
| `endIcon`                   | `ReactNode`            | none        | none                    | An icon after the label, in reading order. Hidden from screen readers: the label names the button.                                                  |
| `focusableWhenDisabled`     | `boolean`              | `false`     | `focusableWhenDisabled` | Inherited from Base UI with its JSDoc: whether the button stays focusable when disabled.                                                            |
| `nativeButton`              | `boolean`              | `true`      | `nativeButton`          | Inherited from Base UI with its JSDoc: set it to `false` when `render` gives an element that isn't a `<button>`.                                    |
| `render`                    | Base UI's `render`     | none        | `render`                | Inherited from Base UI: swaps the root element and keeps the behaviour, the class and the data attributes.                                          |
| `children`                  | `ReactNode`            | none        | none                    | The label: the words that name the action, in sentence case. Required in practice: a button with no words is an IconButton.                         |
| `className`, `style`, `ref` | React's                | none        | `className`, `style`    | Reach the root. `className` is merged after `pn-Button`.                                                                                            |

No `slotProps`: Button has one Base UI part, `Button`, which is the root, and the root takes the component's own props. The label and icon spans are not Base UI parts. No label-override props: Button owns no strings.

Button passes Base UI's `focusableWhenDisabled` and `nativeButton` through unchanged, keeping their Base UI JSDoc: `nativeButton={false}` lets `render` give a non-button element without a development warning, and `focusableWhenDisabled` lets a disabled button keep focus in a toolbar or explain itself through a tooltip.

Button offers `endIcon` beside `startIcon`, though the code map maps only `startIcon`: the contract names the two as a pair, MUI's Button takes both, and a "Next" or "Open in Rejseplanen" action reads with its icon after the words.

Button offers `fullWidth`, which the read-back doesn't show: a bottom sheet's main action fills the sheet on a phone, the contract names `fullWidth` as its example boolean, and it is MUI's Button prop.

## Tokens

One row per part, state and property. States are the contract's design states; Penpot's `State` values map through the code map: `default` is rest, `hover` is `:hover` inside `@media (hover: hover)`, `focus` is `:focus-visible`, `disabled` is `[data-disabled]`; pressed, which the read-back doesn't draw, is `:active`. Every `color` row sets the root's `color`, which the label and both icons take, since icons draw in `currentColor`.

All variants and colours:

| Part                   | State | Property                    | Token                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | ----- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `root`, medium         | rest  | `height`                    | `size.button`                                                                                                                                    |
| `root`, medium         | rest  | `padding-inline`            | `space.400`                                                                                                                                      |
| `root`, medium         | rest  | `gap`                       | `space.200`                                                                                                                                      |
| `root`, small          | rest  | `height`                    | `size.button-sm`                                                                                                                                 |
| `root`, small          | rest  | `padding-inline`            | `space.300`                                                                                                                                      |
| `root`, small          | rest  | `gap`                       | `space.150`                                                                                                                                      |
| `root`                 | rest  | `border-radius`             | `radius.md`                                                                                                                                      |
| `root`                 | rest  | `border-width`              | `border.width.025`                                                                                                                               |
| `label`                | rest  | `font`, `letter-spacing`    | `typography.label`, with its tracking twin                                                                                                       |
| `startIcon`, `endIcon` | rest  | `--perron-icon-size`        | `icon.size.400`                                                                                                                                  |
| `root`                 | focus | `outline`, `outline-offset` | `focus.width` in `color.border.focus`, `focus.offset` (drawn by `perron.css`)                                                                    |
| `focusRing`            | focus | ring corner radius          | `radius.lg`, as drawn: the outline follows the root's `radius.md` out by `focus.offset` plus `focus.width`, so the CSS sets no radius of its own |

`solid`, `neutral`:

| Part   | State    | Property           | Token                         |
| ------ | -------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------- |
| `root` | rest     | `background-color` | `color.surface.inverse`       |
| `root` | rest     | `border-color`     | `transparent`                 |
| `root` | rest     | `color`            | `color.text.inverse`          |
| `root` | hover    | `background-color` | `color.surface.inverse-hover` |
| `root` | pressed  | `background-color` | `color.surface.inverse-hover` |
| `root` | disabled | `background-color` | `color.surface.inset`         |
| `root` | disabled | `color`            | `color.text.tertiary`         |

`solid`, `brand`:

| Part   | State    | Property           | Token                       |
| ------ | -------- | ------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `root` | rest     | `background-color` | `color.surface.brand`       |
| `root` | rest     | `border-color`     | `color.border.brand`        |
| `root` | rest     | `color`            | `color.text.on-color.dark`  |
| `root` | hover    | `background-color` | `color.surface.brand-hover` |
| `root` | pressed  | `background-color` | `color.surface.brand-hover` |
| `root` | disabled | `background-color` | `color.surface.inset`       |
| `root` | disabled | `border-color`     | `transparent`               |
| `root` | disabled | `color`            | `color.text.tertiary`       |

`outline`, `neutral`:

| Part   | State    | Property           | Token                  |
| ------ | -------- | ------------------ | ---------------------- |
| `root` | rest     | `background-color` | `transparent`          |
| `root` | rest     | `border-color`     | `color.border.control` |
| `root` | rest     | `color`            | `color.text.primary`   |
| `root` | hover    | `background-color` | `color.surface.hover`  |
| `root` | pressed  | `background-color` | `color.surface.hover`  |
| `root` | disabled | `border-color`     | `color.border.subtle`  |
| `root` | disabled | `color`            | `color.text.tertiary`  |

`outline`, `brand`:

| Part   | State    | Property           | Token                 |
| ------ | -------- | ------------------ | --------------------- |
| `root` | rest     | `background-color` | `transparent`         |
| `root` | rest     | `border-color`     | `color.border.brand`  |
| `root` | rest     | `color`            | `color.text.brand`    |
| `root` | hover    | `background-color` | `color.surface.hover` |
| `root` | pressed  | `background-color` | `color.surface.hover` |
| `root` | disabled | `border-color`     | `color.border.subtle` |
| `root` | disabled | `color`            | `color.text.tertiary` |

A brand outline button takes `color.surface.hover` on hover, as the neutral outline does, not `color.surface.brand-subtle`: `color.surface.hover` is the hover layer every control shares, and `brand-subtle` is a tinted background, not a state.

A disabled brand button looks exactly like a disabled neutral one (solid: `color.surface.inset` with no edge; outline: a `color.border.subtle` edge), with `color.text.tertiary` text: disabled is a colour, and a yellow that can't be pressed shouldn't still mark the main action.

The read-back shows no pressed state, which a native button has (`:active`). Pressed takes the hover row's tokens, in a rule outside `@media (hover: hover)` so a touch press shows too: no token is made for a pressed fill, and a press on a phone otherwise shows nothing.

## Keyboard and ARIA

From the Base UI reference for `Button` and the installed `useButton`. "From" says who does it.

| Key                | Does                                                                                            | From                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `Tab`, `Shift+Tab` | Moves focus to the button and away; a disabled button is skipped unless `focusableWhenDisabled` | The browser, and Base UI                       |
| `Enter`            | Activates the button: fires `onClick`, or submits the form with `type="submit"`                 | The browser; Base UI for a non-button `render` |
| `Space`            | Activates the button on release                                                                 | The browser; Base UI for a non-button `render` |

| Element                | Role                                                                                    | Accessible name from                                                                            | States announced                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `root`                 | `button`, native; `role="button"` from Base UI when `render` gives a non-button element | Its text content: the label's `children`; `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` from the caller win | Disabled: the native `disabled`, or `aria-disabled` with `focusableWhenDisabled` |
| `startIcon`, `endIcon` | none: `aria-hidden="true"`                                                              | none                                                                                            | none                                                                             |

What axe won't catch, from the contract, each with how this component meets it:

- [ ] Everything the eye is told, the ear is told, for every shape each prop accepts: the label is text the button is named by; the icons are `aria-hidden`, since an icon beside a word adds nothing the word doesn't say ([Icons](../foundations/icons.md#style)); `color` and `variant` carry emphasis, not meaning, and disabled is announced by the native attribute.
- [ ] Every landmark and named region has an accessible name: none here; a button is neither.
- [ ] Every default label can be overridden: none here; Button owns no strings.
- [ ] Every shape the type accepts renders, in every variant: `children`, `startIcon` and `endIcon` render a string, an element and a list alike, in every `variant`, `color` and `size`.
- [ ] A hidden copy kept for animation is `aria-hidden`, and a collapsed region is `inert`: none here; Button keeps no hidden copy and collapses nothing.
- [ ] Native semantics first: a native `<button>` from Base UI's `Button`; with `render` and `nativeButton={false}`, Base UI's `role="button"`.
- [ ] Focus moves in reading order and returns on close: the button is one tab stop in document order, and opens nothing of its own to return from.
- [ ] Every target is at least `size.target-min` square: the smallest target is a small button, `size.button-sm` (30 px) tall, and at least that wide with its `space.300` padding on each side and a word between.
- [ ] Loops stop when the system asks for less motion: none here; Button has no loop and no transition.

## Owned strings

No owned strings: every word comes from the caller, as `children`.

## Component rules

Rules for this component alone, numbered so the build and the review can cite them.

- **CR-1.** Base UI's `Button` already renders the native `<button type="button">`, activates on Enter and Space, sets `disabled` and `data-disabled`, and blocks the click of a disabled button, so the component rebuilds none of it and passes `disabled` straight to it.
- **CR-2.** The root always carries `data-variant`, `data-color` and `data-size`, defaults included, and `data-full-width` when `fullWidth`; the CSS selects on them, one class then attributes: `.pn-Button[data-variant='outline'][data-color='brand']`.
- **CR-3.** The states keep the button's geometry: hover, pressed, focus and disabled change colours only, never the height, padding, gap, border width or radius, so nothing moves when the state changes.
- **CR-4.** Hover is read inside `@media (hover: hover)` and never applies to a disabled button: the hover rule excludes `[data-disabled]`, since a native disabled button still matches `:hover`.
- **CR-5.** Focus uses the ring `perron.css` draws on `:focus-visible`; the component draws no ring of its own and never removes the outline. The focus state otherwise looks like rest.
- **CR-6.** The colour is set on the root's `color`; the label and the icons take it, the icons through `currentColor`. No rule sets a colour on an icon.
- **CR-7.** The icon spans are `aria-hidden="true"`, rendered only when their prop is given, and set `--perron-icon-size` to `icon.size.400` in both sizes, so an icon from `packages/perron/icons/` (drawn on the 16 px grid for controls) renders at its own step.
- **CR-8.** Changes of state are immediate: no `duration.*` token fits a button's state change, so the CSS has no transition.
- **CR-9.** `{...rest}` reaches the root before the component's own attributes, and `variant`, `color`, `size`, `fullWidth`, `startIcon` and `endIcon` are taken out of `rest` first, so none reaches the DOM.
- **CR-10.** A `brand` button keeps its `color.border.brand` edge at rest, on hover and pressed, in both variants: the light-theme yellow fill reaches only 2.1:1 on the surfaces, and the edge carries the 3:1 ([Semantic colours](../foundations/semantic-colours.md#brand)).

- **CR-11.** Every variant draws a `border.width.025` border, `transparent` on a neutral solid button and a disabled solid one, so all four looks share one width and height, the label sits in the same place, and Windows' forced colours draw an edge round every button: a border only some buttons carry makes a brand button 2 px wider than the same neutral one.
- **CR-12.** The label stays on one line (`white-space: nowrap`), the button growing with it, rather than wrapping inside the fixed `size.button` height: a wrapped label would overflow it, and button labels are short by content design.
- **CR-13.** Pressed (`:active`) takes the hover row's tokens, in a rule outside `@media (hover: hover)` so a press on a touch screen shows, and, like hover, never applies to a disabled button: the rule excludes `[data-disabled]`, since a button with `focusableWhenDisabled` has no native `disabled` and still matches `:active`.

## Stories

The deferred design's variant properties, in this order: `variant` (`solid`, `outline`), `color` (`neutral`, `brand`), `size` (`medium`, `small`) and `State` (`default`, `hover`, `focus`, `disabled`). Each story is named by its variant name (`penpot/README.md`, "Conventions"), renders the label "Show departures", as the read-back does, and sets `disabled` for a `Disabled` story. The hover and focus stories render at rest: the visual check drives the state itself, and their `play` tests check it.

`color` is a variant property, after `variant`, so the stories and a later drawing's exports are named `SolidNeutralMediumDefault` and `SolidBrandMediumDefault` rather than the read-back's `SolidMediumDefault`, 32 variants in all: the contract gives every action component `brand` beside `neutral`, and the design run that ends the deferral redraws the page with it.

| Story                          | Shows                                                                                              | `play` test                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `SolidNeutralMediumDefault`    | solid, neutral, medium, at rest                                                                    | Tab focuses the button, Enter and Space each fire `onClick` once, Shift+Tab returns focus   |
| `SolidNeutralMediumHover`      | solid, neutral, medium, hover                                                                      | Hovering sets the `color.surface.inverse-hover` fill                                        |
| `SolidNeutralMediumFocus`      | solid, neutral, medium, focus                                                                      | Tab gives the root `:focus-visible` and the ring                                            |
| `SolidNeutralMediumDisabled`   | solid, neutral, medium, disabled                                                                   | The button has `disabled` and `data-disabled`, Tab skips it, and a click fires no `onClick` |
| `SolidNeutralSmallDefault`     | solid, neutral, small, at rest                                                                     | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidNeutralSmallHover`       | solid, neutral, small, hover                                                                       | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidNeutralSmallFocus`       | solid, neutral, small, focus                                                                       | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidNeutralSmallDisabled`    | solid, neutral, small, disabled                                                                    | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandMediumDefault`      | solid, brand, medium, at rest                                                                      | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandMediumHover`        | solid, brand, medium, hover                                                                        | Hovering sets the `color.surface.brand-hover` fill and keeps the `color.border.brand` edge  |
| `SolidBrandMediumFocus`        | solid, brand, medium, focus                                                                        | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandMediumDisabled`     | solid, brand, medium, disabled                                                                     | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandSmallDefault`       | solid, brand, small, at rest                                                                       | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandSmallHover`         | solid, brand, small, hover                                                                         | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandSmallFocus`         | solid, brand, small, focus                                                                         | none                                                                                        |
| `SolidBrandSmallDisabled`      | solid, brand, small, disabled                                                                      | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralMediumDefault`  | outline, neutral, medium, at rest                                                                  | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralMediumHover`    | outline, neutral, medium, hover                                                                    | Hovering lays `color.surface.hover` over the transparent fill                               |
| `OutlineNeutralMediumFocus`    | outline, neutral, medium, focus                                                                    | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralMediumDisabled` | outline, neutral, medium, disabled                                                                 | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralSmallDefault`   | outline, neutral, small, at rest                                                                   | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralSmallHover`     | outline, neutral, small, hover                                                                     | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralSmallFocus`     | outline, neutral, small, focus                                                                     | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineNeutralSmallDisabled`  | outline, neutral, small, disabled                                                                  | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandMediumDefault`    | outline, brand, medium, at rest                                                                    | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandMediumHover`      | outline, brand, medium, hover                                                                      | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandMediumFocus`      | outline, brand, medium, focus                                                                      | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandMediumDisabled`   | outline, brand, medium, disabled                                                                   | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandSmallDefault`     | outline, brand, small, at rest                                                                     | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandSmallHover`       | outline, brand, small, hover                                                                       | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandSmallFocus`       | outline, brand, small, focus                                                                       | none                                                                                        |
| `OutlineBrandSmallDisabled`    | outline, brand, small, disabled                                                                    | none                                                                                        |
| `WithIcons`                    | solid, neutral, medium, at rest, with a `startIcon` and an `endIcon` from `packages/perron/icons/` | The icon spans are `aria-hidden`, and the button's accessible name is the label alone       |
| `FullWidth`                    | solid, brand, medium, at rest, `fullWidth` in a narrow container                                   | The root carries `data-full-width` and is as wide as its container                          |

## Do and don't

For a caller using the component, with the reason.

| Do                                                                                                                                                             | Don't                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Give one button per screen `color="brand"`, for its main action; the default `neutral` ink is for everything else, so the yellow keeps meaning the main action | Put two brand buttons on one screen, or use `brand` for emphasis: a second yellow action leaves neither the main one                              |
| Name the action in sentence case, as a verb and what it acts on: "Show departures", "Show whole line"                                                          | Write "OK", "Click here", Title Case or an exclamation mark ([Content design](../content-design.md))                                              |
| Use IconButton for a button with an icon and no words, so it gets its required label                                                                           | Pass only a `startIcon` and no `children`: the icon is `aria-hidden`, so the button has no name                                                   |
| Use `solid` for the action a panel is for and `outline` for the actions beside it                                                                              | Mark the main action with `outline`, or set every action in a row `solid`                                                                         |
| Set `type="submit"` on a form's submit button; Base UI's default is `type="button"`                                                                            | Rely on a button submitting its form: without `type="submit"` it doesn't                                                                          |
| Pass `nativeButton={false}` with `render` when it gives an element that isn't a `<button>`                                                                     | Render a link with `render={<a href="/map" />}` for navigation: LinkButton is that component, and a button that navigates misleads screen readers |
| Keep a brand button out of rows of line and mode badges                                                                                                        | Set a brand button among bus badges, whose fill and ink label it shares, where it reads as one                                                    |
| Set `disabled` when the action can't run, with a reason in words nearby, or `focusableWhenDisabled` so the button can carry it                                 | Restyle a disabled button with `opacity`: disabled is `color.text.tertiary`, a colour                                                             |

title: IconButton
markdown:
# IconButton

A button that runs one action and shows it as an icon alone, such as zoom in or show help, named for screen readers by its required `label`.

The design is deferred (ADR 0010, `docs/adr/0010-unattended-runs-with-design-deferred.md`): there is no read-back, code map or export, and this spec decides what the drawing would, from the contract, the foundations, the tokens, the Base UI reference and the spec of its sibling [Button](button.md), a source it follows rather than a dependency: IconButton builds on Base UI's `Button` and the `VisuallyHidden` part, not on Perron's Button. The [Toolbar](toolbar.md) spec gives its icon-only buttons the look and size answered below, and this spec follows it so the two match side by side.

## Anatomy

Penpot page `Components/IconButton`. Family: none (the contract's [Families](README.md#families) give buttons only their text, and an icon button shows none). Shared parts: `VisuallyHidden`, which holds the label: the contract composes it in "any component with a word the eye gets from an icon or a shape".

| Part (Penpot layer) | What it is                                                                                                                                                                             | Base UI part                                           | Class                | `slotProps` key |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------- | --------------- |
| `root`              | The native `<button>`: a square, `size.control` both ways, that centres the icon                                                                                                       | `Button`                                               | `pn-IconButton`      | none            |
| `icon`              | A `<span>`, `aria-hidden`, that holds the caller's `children`, the icon                                                                                                                | none: a span inside `Button`, which has no inner parts | `pn-IconButton-icon` | none            |
| `label`             | The `VisuallyHidden` span that holds the caller's `label`, the words that name the button. Never seen, so a drawing has no layer for it                                                | none: the `VisuallyHidden` shared part inside `Button` | `pn-VisuallyHidden`  | none            |
| `focusRing`         | The keyboard focus ring, as on Button: the `:focus-visible` outline `perron.css` draws on the root, not an element. A drawing shows it as a layer named `focusRing` on the focus state | `Button`                                               | none                 | none            |

## Base UI parts

Imported from `@base-ui/react/button`, at the version pinned in `package.json` (1.9.0 installed).

| Base UI part | Renders                                                                                     | Perron sets                                                                                                                                                                                      | Passed through                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Button`     | `<button type="button">`, or the element `render` gives, with `data-disabled` when disabled | `className` (`pn-IconButton`, then the caller's), `style`, `ref`, `disabled` from `disabled`, `data-color` and `data-size` from their props (defaults included), and the icon and label children | `render`, `nativeButton`, `focusableWhenDisabled`, `type`, `onClick`, `aria-*` and every other prop of a native `<button>`, through `{...rest}` |

Base UI already does: it renders a native `<button>` with `type="button"`, which a caller's `type="submit"` overrides; Enter and Space activate it through the browser; when disabled it sets the native `disabled` attribute and `data-disabled`, and stops `onClick`, `onMouseDown` and `onPointerDown` from reaching the caller; with `focusableWhenDisabled` it sets `aria-disabled` in place of `disabled`, keeps the button in the tab order and lets only Tab through; with `render` and `nativeButton={false}` it gives a non-button element `role="button"`, a `tabIndex` and Enter and Space activation, and in development it warns when `nativeButton` doesn't match the rendered element.

## Props

In MUI's layout, as MUI's IconButton takes its icon as `children`. Every prop the component declares gets this description as its JSDoc; the inherited rows keep Base UI's. Slots come last.

The button is named by a required `label: string` prop, rendered as text inside the button through the `VisuallyHidden` shared part, rather than by the caller's `aria-label`. The type then makes the name impossible to forget, which Button's spec promises ("so it gets its required label"); the contract composes `VisuallyHidden` for a word the eye gets from an icon; and a page translator rewrites text inside the button, where it leaves an `aria-label` in the other language. A caller's `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` still wins, through `{...rest}`.

IconButton takes a `size` of `'medium' | 'large'`, default `'medium'`, that keeps the `size.control` square and sets only the icon's step: `icon.size.400` for `medium`, `icon.size.450` for `large`. [Icons](../foundations/icons.md#sizes) gives `icon.size.450` to "top bar buttons" (`monitor` and `info`, drawn on the 18 px grid), which are icon buttons, and an icon drawn on one grid must not be scaled to another; no token gives an icon button a second box size.

IconButton leaves out MUI IconButton's `edge` and `loading`. No source asks for either: the screens place their buttons with layout gaps, and no Perron component shows a loading indicator yet. Each can join later as a new optional prop, which the contract's [Change](README.md#change) rule allows.

| Name                        | Type                   | Default     | Base UI prop         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label`                     | `string`               | none        | none                 | The words that name the action, in sentence case, such as "Zoom in". Required: the icon is hidden from screen readers, so these words are the button's name. Never seen, read by screen readers. |
| `color`                     | `'neutral' \| 'brand'` | `'neutral'` | none                 | The intent: `neutral` is quiet ink, for every action but the main one; `brand` is the brand yellow, for the one main action of a screen.                                                         |
| `size`                      | `'medium' \| 'large'`  | `'medium'`  | none                 | The icon's step in the `size.control` square: `medium` is `icon.size.400`, for icons drawn on the 16 px grid; `large` is `icon.size.450`, for the top bar's icons drawn on the 18 px grid.       |
| `disabled`                  | `boolean`              | `false`     | `disabled`           | Whether the button ignores the pointer and the keys. A disabled button leaves the tab order unless `focusableWhenDisabled` is set.                                                               |
| `focusableWhenDisabled`     | `boolean`              | `false`     | inherited            | Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.                                                                                                                                            |
| `nativeButton`              | `boolean`              | `true`      | inherited            | Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).                |
| `render`                    | Base UI's `render`     | none        | inherited            | Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.        |
| `children`                  | `ReactNode`            | none        | none                 | The icon, such as an SVG from `packages/perron/icons/` with the `perron-icon` class. Hidden from screen readers: `label` names the button.                                                       |
| `className`, `style`, `ref` | React's                | none        | `className`, `style` | Reach the root. `className` is merged after `pn-IconButton`.                                                                                                                                     |

No `slotProps`: IconButton has one Base UI part, `Button`, which is the root, and the root takes the component's own props. The icon span and the label's `VisuallyHidden` are not Base UI parts. No label-override props: `label` is the caller's word, not an owned string.

## Tokens

One row per part, state and property. States are the contract's design states; the deferred design's `State` values map as Button's do: `default` is rest, `hover` is `:hover` inside `@media (hover: hover)`, `focus` is `:focus-visible`, `disabled` is `[data-disabled]`; pressed, which the design doesn't draw, is `:active`. Every `color` row sets the root's `color`, which the icon takes through `currentColor`.

IconButton has no `variant` prop and one look per colour, as Toolbar's icon-only buttons have: `neutral` quiet (transparent at rest in `color.text.primary`, `color.surface.hover` on hover and press), `brand` a solid brand button (`color.surface.brand` with a `color.border.brand` edge and `color.text.on-color.dark`, `color.surface.brand-hover` on hover and press). Icon buttons sit on panels, sheets and the top bar's glass, which already mark where they are; the brand is calm, with ink and neutral surfaces around the map; MUI's IconButton has no `variant` either; and a toolbar of icon buttons then matches the IconButtons beside it.

IconButton leaves out a toggled ("pressed") state, `aria-pressed` and the `color.surface.inverse` fill whose description names "pressed icon buttons", leaving an icon that turns something on and off to a component on Base UI's `Toggle`. IconButton's one Base UI part is `Button`, which keeps no pressed state; [Accessibility](../foundations/accessibility.md#rules) wants a toggle's state said in words as well as looks, which a label-only button can't show; and FilterChip and HighlightChip, on `Toggle`, are the roadmap's toggles.

Every colour and size:

| Part        | State | Property                    | Token                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | ----- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `root`      | rest  | `width`, `height`           | `size.control`                                                                                                                            |
| `root`      | rest  | `padding`                   | 0                                                                                                                                         |
| `root`      | rest  | `border-radius`             | `radius.md`                                                                                                                               |
| `root`      | rest  | `border-width`              | `border.width.025`                                                                                                                        |
| `root`      | rest  | `--perron-icon-size`        | `icon.size.400` when `size` is `medium`, `icon.size.450` when `large`, inherited by the icon                                              |
| `root`      | focus | `outline`, `outline-offset` | `focus.width` in `color.border.focus`, `focus.offset` (drawn by `perron.css`)                                                             |
| `focusRing` | focus | ring corner radius          | `radius.lg`, as Button's: the outline follows the root's `radius.md` out by `focus.offset` plus `focus.width`, and the CSS sets no radius |

`neutral`:

| Part   | State    | Property           | Token                 |
| ------ | -------- | ------------------ | --------------------- |
| `root` | rest     | `background-color` | `transparent`         |
| `root` | rest     | `border-color`     | `transparent`         |
| `root` | rest     | `color`            | `color.text.primary`  |
| `root` | hover    | `background-color` | `color.surface.hover` |
| `root` | pressed  | `background-color` | `color.surface.hover` |
| `root` | disabled | `background-color` | `transparent`         |
| `root` | disabled | `color`            | `color.text.tertiary` |

`brand`:

| Part   | State    | Property           | Token                       |
| ------ | -------- | ------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `root` | rest     | `background-color` | `color.surface.brand`       |
| `root` | rest     | `border-color`     | `color.border.brand`        |
| `root` | rest     | `color`            | `color.text.on-color.dark`  |
| `root` | hover    | `background-color` | `color.surface.brand-hover` |
| `root` | pressed  | `background-color` | `color.surface.brand-hover` |
| `root` | disabled | `background-color` | `color.surface.inset`       |
| `root` | disabled | `border-color`     | `transparent`               |
| `root` | disabled | `color`            | `color.text.tertiary`       |

A disabled brand icon button looks like Button's disabled solid one, `color.surface.inset` with `color.text.tertiary` and no edge: disabled is a colour, and a yellow that can't be pressed shouldn't still mark the main action.

Pressed takes the hover row's tokens, in a rule outside `@media (hover: hover)` so a press on a touch screen shows, as on Button: no token is made for a pressed fill.

Highlighted, open, selected and invalid don't apply: Base UI's `Button` produces only `data-disabled`, a button takes focus rather than `data-highlighted`, a popup trigger given through `render` keeps the button's look while its popup is open, and an icon button holds no choice or value.

## Keyboard and ARIA

From the Base UI reference for `Button` and the installed `useButton`, as on Button. "From" says who does it.

| Key                | Does                                                                                            | From                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `Tab`, `Shift+Tab` | Moves focus to the button and away; a disabled button is skipped unless `focusableWhenDisabled` | The browser, and Base UI                       |
| `Enter`            | Activates the button: fires `onClick`, or submits the form with `type="submit"`                 | The browser; Base UI for a non-button `render` |
| `Space`            | Activates the button on release                                                                 | The browser; Base UI for a non-button `render` |

| Element | Role                                                                                    | Accessible name from                                                                                              | States announced                                                                 |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `root`  | `button`, native; `role="button"` from Base UI when `render` gives a non-button element | Its text content: the `label` in the `VisuallyHidden` span; `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` from the caller win | Disabled: the native `disabled`, or `aria-disabled` with `focusableWhenDisabled` |
| `icon`  | none: `aria-hidden="true"`                                                              | none                                                                                                              | none                                                                             |
| `label` | none: text inside the button                                                            | none: it is the name                                                                                              | none                                                                             |

What axe won't catch, from the contract, each with how this component meets it:

- [ ] Everything the eye is told, the ear is told, for every shape each prop accepts: the icon is `aria-hidden` and `label` says in words what it shows, as [Icons](../foundations/icons.md#style) asks of an icon alone; `color` carries emphasis, not meaning; disabled is announced by the native attribute or `aria-disabled`.
- [ ] Every landmark and named region has an accessible name: none here; a button is neither.
- [ ] Every default label can be overridden: none here; IconButton owns no strings, and `label` is the caller's.
- [ ] Every shape the type accepts renders, in every variant: `children` renders a string, an element and a list alike, centred in the square, in both colours and both sizes, and the icon span clips a string wider than the square so it stays inside; `label` is a `string`.
- [ ] A hidden copy kept for animation is `aria-hidden`, and a collapsed region is `inert`: none here; IconButton keeps no hidden copy and collapses nothing. The `VisuallyHidden` label is the name, not a copy.
- [ ] Native semantics first: a native `<button>` from Base UI's `Button`, named by its own text; with `render` and `nativeButton={false}`, Base UI's `role="button"`. No ARIA of its own.
- [ ] Focus moves in reading order and returns on close: the button is one tab stop in document order, and opens nothing of its own to return from.
- [ ] Every target is at least `size.target-min` square: every IconButton is `size.control` (34 px) square, in both sizes.
- [ ] Loops stop when the system asks for less motion: none here; IconButton has no loop and no transition.

## Owned strings

No owned strings: every word comes from the caller, as `label`.

## Component rules

Rules for this component alone, numbered so the build and the review can cite them.

- **CR-1.** Base UI's `Button` already renders the native `<button type="button">`, activates on Enter and Space, sets `disabled` and `data-disabled`, and blocks the click of a disabled button, so the component rebuilds none of it and passes `disabled` straight to it.
- **CR-2.** The root always carries `data-color` and `data-size`, defaults included; the CSS selects on them, one class then attributes: `.pn-IconButton[data-color='brand']`, `.pn-IconButton[data-size='large']`.
- **CR-3.** The root is a `size.control` square in both sizes, with no padding, and centres the icon (`display: inline-flex`, `align-items` and `justify-content` `center`, `flex: none` so a flex row never squeezes it). The icon span is at most the square and clips what overflows it, so a long string stays inside the square and the root's ring and label are untouched. `size` changes only the icon's step.
- **CR-4.** The states keep the geometry: hover, pressed, focus and disabled change colours only, never the size, border width or radius. Both colours draw a `border.width.025` border, `transparent` on `neutral` and on a disabled `brand`, so the two share one box and Windows' forced colours draw an edge round every icon button.
- **CR-5.** Hover is read inside `@media (hover: hover)`; pressed (`:active`) takes the hover tokens in a rule outside it, so a touch press shows. Neither applies to a disabled button: both rules exclude `[data-disabled]`, since a native disabled button still matches `:hover`, and one with `focusableWhenDisabled` still matches `:active`.
- **CR-6.** Focus uses the ring `perron.css` draws on `:focus-visible`; the component draws no ring of its own and never removes the outline. The focus state otherwise looks like rest.
- **CR-7.** The colour is set on the root's `color`; the icon takes it through `currentColor`. No rule sets a colour on the icon.
- **CR-8.** The icon span is `aria-hidden="true"`, and the root sets `--perron-icon-size`, which the icon inherits: `icon.size.400` for `medium`, `icon.size.450` for `large`, on `.pn-IconButton` and `.pn-IconButton[data-size='large']` with no descendant selector, so an icon from `packages/perron/icons/` renders at the step its grid was drawn for.
- **CR-9.** The label is the caller's `label` inside the `VisuallyHidden` shared part, after the icon span, rendered on every button: the button is named by its own text, the component sets no `aria-label` and no `title`, and `label` is required in `IconButtonProps`.
- **CR-10.** A `brand` icon button keeps its `color.border.brand` edge at rest, on hover and pressed: the light-theme yellow fill reaches only 2.1:1 on the surfaces, and the edge carries the 3:1 ([Semantic colours](../foundations/semantic-colours.md#brand)).
- **CR-11.** Changes of state are immediate: no `duration.*` token fits a button's state change, so the CSS has no transition.
- **CR-12.** `{...rest}` reaches the root before the component's own attributes, and `label`, `color`, `size` and `children` are taken out of `rest` first, so none reaches the DOM as an attribute.
- **CR-13.** In forced colours, a disabled icon button draws its edge and its icon in `GrayText`, inside `@media (forced-colors: active)`, as Button does.
- **CR-14.** IconButton keeps no toggled state: it sets no `aria-pressed`, and no rule reads one.

## Stories

The deferred design's variant properties, in this order: `color` (`neutral`, `brand`), `size` (`medium`, `large`) and `State` (`default`, `hover`, `focus`, `disabled`). Each story is named by its variant name (`penpot/README.md`, "Conventions"). A `medium` story renders `packages/perron/icons/`'s `plus` with the label "Zoom in"; a `large` one renders `info`, drawn on the 18 px grid, with the label "Show help". A `Disabled` story sets `disabled`. The hover and focus stories render at rest: the visual check drives the state itself, and their `play` tests check it.

| Story                   | Shows                     | `play` test                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NeutralMediumDefault`  | neutral, medium, at rest  | The button's accessible name is "Zoom in" and its icon span is `aria-hidden`; Tab focuses it, Enter and Space each fire `onClick` once, Shift+Tab returns focus |
| `NeutralMediumHover`    | neutral, medium, hover    | Hovering lays `color.surface.hover` over the transparent fill                                                                                                   |
| `NeutralMediumFocus`    | neutral, medium, focus    | Tab gives the root `:focus-visible` and the ring                                                                                                                |
| `NeutralMediumDisabled` | neutral, medium, disabled | The button has `disabled` and `data-disabled`, Tab skips it, and a click fires no `onClick`                                                                     |
| `NeutralLargeDefault`   | neutral, large, at rest   | The root is `size.control` square, as in `medium`, and the icon renders at `icon.size.450`                                                                      |
| `NeutralLargeHover`     | neutral, large, hover     | none                                                                                                                                                            |
| `NeutralLargeFocus`     | neutral, large, focus     | none                                                                                                                                                            |
| `NeutralLargeDisabled`  | neutral, large, disabled  | none                                                                                                                                                            |
